Kunwar Singh's fresh rising in Bihar

cards.title: Azimullah Khan
lines: Nana's adviser; went to **London** for the pension case

boxes.title: Bahadur Shah Zafar
items: Wrote to princely states: mostly ignored, but spread the rising
Proclamations: Hindu-Muslim unity, ==**ban on cow slaughter**==, joint commands
Captured after Delhi fell, tried, exiled to **Burma**

boxes.title: Rajputana & Central India
head: Place
Feature
rows: Sepoy risings June 1857 (⚠ some notes: Nasirabad May)
His troops ==went over to the Rani==
Suppression forces came from unaffected areas

boxes.title: Andhra & aftermath
items: Paralakimidi then in **Ganjam**; Dandasena rose after ==ban on selling forest produce==; hanged
Nizam Afzal-ud-Daula = **Asaf Jah V**; APHQ 2025: "Andhra unaffected for want of local leaders" = **false**
APPSC-GS 2024: widespread but failed, began at Meerut = all true
**GoI Act 1858**: power to Crown; **Secretary of State**; G-G made ==**Viceroy**==
Failure: no coordination, central leadership, programme; urban elites and big princes stayed away
